name: FLEXI
recent: FLEXI 在 2026 年 9 月底至 10 月中出现董事兼大股东 Tan Kong Leong 一连串在公开市场增持股份的申报，另有 Phitchaya Arsangku 的股东权益变动申报。公司于 11 月 25 日公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度的合并业绩。
notable: 董事经理 Tan Kong Leong 于 2026 年 9 月 29 日至 10 月 12 日期间多次在公开市场增持公司普通股。
公司于 2026 年 11 月 25 日发布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度的合并业绩。

recent_en: FLEXI saw a series of announcements in late September to mid-October 2026 on Managing Director and substantial shareholder Tan Kong Leong acquiring shares in the open market, alongside changes in substantial shareholder interest for Phitchaya Arsangku. The company released its consolidated quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 25 November.
notable_en: Managing Director Tan Kong Leong acquired ordinary shares in the open market on multiple occasions between 29 September and 12 October 2026.
The company released its consolidated results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 on 25 November 2026.
